context.product_surface: Final review and confirmation step for a bank transfer

primary_user.job: Verify the destination and total debit before submitting one transfer

context.outcome: The customer understands the commitment, submits once, and can distinguish success from recoverable failure
constraints: Desktop and mobile use the same backend flow
A submitted transfer cannot be silently reversed
Do not assume an existing design system
assumptions: The recipient and amount were entered in an earlier step

evidence.claim: The review must show recipient, masked account, amount, fee, total debit, date, optional note, and named failure classes
The web interface targets keyboard access, visible focus, semantics, names, announcements, and reflow

evidence.locator: Evaluation brief: no existing design system supplied
evidence.claim: Visual values are proposed defaults until rendered comparison or product guidance exists

decisions.decision: Keep review and final commitment as separate user actions
decisions.tradeoff: Adds one intentional step to prevent an unreviewed irreversible submission

decisions.decision: Use one information order and adapt only the spatial composition
decisions.tradeoff: Preserves parity while requiring rendered checks across content-driven transitions

decisions.decision: Product must decide whether an expired session preserves the prepared transfer after reauthentication
decisions.tradeoff: Preservation reduces re-entry but depends on security and backend policy

contracts.requirement: Submission is unavailable until the complete review content is present and the customer explicitly activates Confirm transfer
Total debit is visually dominant within the financial summary and remains adjacent to amount and fee
Insufficient funds, daily limit, network loss, and expired session produce distinct task-local states with a next action and duplicate-submission protection
Recipient, account, financial summary, date, note, back action, and confirm action remain available from 320 through 1440 CSS pixels without page-level horizontal scrolling
The confirmation control has a visible label, native button semantics, visible focus, keyboard activation, busy state, and task-local result announcement
Recipient, note, labels, and monetary values wrap or reflow without losing complete task-critical content under representative localization stress
Motion is not required to understand pending, success, or error state and adapts to reduced-motion preference
Expired-session recovery behavior is not implementation-ready until preservation and reauthentication policy is decided

flows.name: Review and submit one transfer
flows.entry: Recipient and amount are present from the previous step
steps: Review recipient identity, masked account, amount, fee, total debit, execution date, and note
Return to editing if any reviewed value is wrong
Observe pending followed by success or a named recoverable failure
flows.success: A stable confirmation identifies the submitted transfer and prevents another accidental submission
alternate_and_recovery: Back returns to editing without losing entered values
Network loss retains the review and exposes retry
Insufficient funds and daily limit explain the blocking condition
Expired session follows the unresolved reauthentication policy

layout.wide: Use one bounded review column with financial values aligned for scanning and actions adjacent to the decision region
layout.intermediate: Preserve the same region order while allowing labels and values to wrap before changing composition
layout.narrow: Use one normal-flow column; keep the confirmation action reachable after the complete review without hiding content
transitions: Change composition when reviewed labels, values, and actions no longer fit without collision
Keep the same DOM and reading order across compositions

color_roles: Reuse project semantic roles when discovered; proposed roles are surface, text, muted text, border, accent, danger, and success
typography_roles: Use distinct roles for page heading, reviewed label, reviewed value, dominant total, and task feedback
spacing_and_grid: Use the existing spacing scale when discovered and preserve one alignment edge for labels, values, and feedback
shape_and_elevation: Use existing surface and control treatment; no new decorative card language is required
iconography_and_imagery: Icons supplement visible text and never carry financial state alone
motion: Use motion only to preserve state continuity; pending and result meaning remain available when motion is removed

components.name: Transfer review summary
components.purpose: Present every value required for the commitment decision

not_applicable_states.focus_visible: The summary itself is not interactive
not_applicable_states.loading: The view owns loading before the summary is complete
not_applicable_states.error: Task feedback is rendered adjacent to the action region
not_applicable_states.success: The view replaces the decision state with a stable result

accessibility.name_role_value: Use semantic text and grouping; financial labels remain programmatically associated with values
accessibility.focus: Static summary is not added to the tab order
accessibility.announcements: Static review content is not announced as a live update

content_constraints: Never truncate recipient, total debit, or fee
Omit the note row when the optional note is absent
components.responsive_behavior: Reflow label/value pairs and allow content growth without changing information order

components.name: Confirm transfer action
components.purpose: Commit exactly one reviewed transfer and expose its result

not_applicable_states.selected: The action is not a selection control
not_applicable_states.empty: Empty review is a view-level state

interactions: Enter, Space, or pointer activation submits once
Loading blocks duplicate activation while keeping the action label recognizable
Retry submits only after a recoverable failure

accessibility.name_role_value: Native button named Confirm transfer; busy and disabled state are exposed
accessibility.keyboard: Enter and Space activate when available
accessibility.focus: Focus remains task-local through pending and moves only when the stable result requires it
accessibility.announcements: Pending is polite; blocking failure is associated with the action; success is announced once

content_constraints: Failure message identifies the condition and next action
Do not replace the label with spinner-only feedback
components.responsive_behavior: Remain in normal flow and reachable after the review at every supported width

acceptance_criteria.given: A valid recipient and amount from the previous step
acceptance_criteria.then: Recipient, masked account, amount, fee, total debit, date, note state, Back, and Confirm transfer are available before submission
acceptance_criteria.evidence: DOM assertions plus matched desktop and mobile renders

acceptance_criteria.when: Submission returns insufficient funds, daily limit, network loss, or expired session
acceptance_criteria.then: The named state explains what happened, preserves reviewed context, prevents duplicate submission, and exposes the applicable next action
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Interaction traces for every named failure and retry path

acceptance_criteria.when: Rendered at narrow, intermediate, and wide content-driven conditions
acceptance_criteria.then: All reviewed values and actions remain reachable with no page-level horizontal scroll
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Matched viewport screenshots, geometry, and overflow assertions

acceptance_criteria.when: They review, go back, submit, encounter a recoverable failure, and retry
acceptance_criteria.then: The path completes with native semantics, visible focus, logical focus order, and task-local announcements
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Complete keyboard trace, accessibility-tree snapshot, and named assistive-technology test for announcements

acceptance_criteria.given: Representative long recipient names, notes, localized labels, and formatted monetary values
acceptance_criteria.when: The review is rendered from 320 through 1440 CSS pixels and with text enlargement
acceptance_criteria.then: Task-critical content remains complete, associated, and reachable without silent truncation
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Pseudo-localized renders, representative locales, text enlargement, and overflow assertions

acceptance_criteria.when: Pending, success, and error states change
acceptance_criteria.then: State meaning remains complete without required spatial motion
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Media assertion, computed styles, and reduced-motion state captures

open_questions.question: After reauthentication, is the prepared transfer restored or must the customer start again?
open_questions.impact: Changes expired-session recovery, security review, and acceptance criteria
